scenes.say: I asked three AIs to build me a habit tracker.
One prompt. One file. Then I ran the exact same test on all three: add two habits, tick today, reload the page.

scenes.label: ChatGPT
scenes.caption: clean, simple, everything saved
scenes.say: ChatGPT: clean, simple, everything saved. Ten.

scenes.label: Claude
scenes.caption: “haven't clicked through it” honest 😅
scenes.say: Claude: week navigation, even a warning if storage fails. And it honestly admitted it hadn't clicked through it. Ten.

scenes.label: Gemini
scenes.caption: 3-day water streak… before I drank anything
scenes.say: Gemini built the prettiest app by far. But it gave me a three-day water streak before I drank anything.

scenes.label: Gemini
scenes.caption: complete Wednesday on Monday 🚀
scenes.say: And it lets you complete Wednesday on Monday. Productivity unlocked. Eight.
The good news? All three apps actually work.
